XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS AI Quiz Generation — Phase G.0 (MVP) schema. Two tables: drafts (one row per generation request) + questions (one row per generated question, FK to draft).

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_aiquiz_draft
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase G.0 (2026-05-24) — One row per AI-generation request. Lifecycle: pending (created, API call in flight) → generated (Claude returned, questions persisted, awaiting review) → approved (all questions reviewed + at least one approved) → pushed (approved questions copied to mod_quiz) → rejected (reviewer dismissed the whole draft).
The `sourcetext` column carries the verbatim text that was sent to Claude — kept for traceability so we can re-generate against the same input with a new prompt version. PII screening is the trainer's responsibility (the UI warns them at paste time).
`prompt_version` ties each draft to a versioned system prompt; new prompt revisions get a new version string so we can A/B test prompt quality without losing the audit trail.
`customerid` + `costcenterid` follow the standard Sentientia LMS multi-customer / multi-tenant scope convention.

FIELD.NAME: courseid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to course.id — the course the quiz draft belongs to. 0 = site-level (not yet assigned).

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — Course Author who created the draft.

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: costcenterid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root (1=Airpay, 77=Public, 177=ZEEA). Derived from creator open_path at draft time.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer-supplied draft title for the review queue list.

FIELD.NAME: sourcetext
FIELD.COMMENT: The verbatim text sent to Claude as the user message. Trim/dedupe is the trainer's responsibility.

FIELD.NAME: model
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic model identifier used for the generation. Recorded for audit.

FIELD.NAME: prompt_version
FIELD.COMMENT: System-prompt revision tag (e.g. v1, v2-hindi). Allows safe A/B prompt-quality testing.

FIELD.NAME: num_requested
FIELD.COMMENT: How many questions the trainer asked for.

FIELD.NAME: num_generated
FIELD.COMMENT: How many questions Claude actually returned (parser-validated).

FIELD.NAME: tokens_in
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic input_tokens reported by API for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: tokens_out
FIELD.COMMENT: Anthropic output_tokens reported by API for cost tracking.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: pending | generated | approved | pushed | rejected | failed

FIELD.NAME: error_detail
FIELD.COMMENT: On status=failed: the exception message + HTTP code (no API key, never log keys).

FIELD.NAME: reviewed_by
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id of the trainer who completed the review (NULL until reviewed).

FIELD.NAME: reviewed_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp when review completed.

FIELD.NAME: pushed_quizid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to mod_quiz.id once status=pushed. NULL until then.

FIELD.NAME: generated_at
FIELD.COMMENT: Unix timestamp of generation completion (or attempt timestamp on failure).

INDEX.NAME: idx_owner_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Trainer review queue: 'my drafts awaiting review'

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_aiquiz_question
TABLE.COMMENT:
Phase G.0 (2026-05-24) — One row per generated question. Cascade-delete with parent draft.
`qtype` is restricted in Phase G.0 to 'multichoice' (4 options, exactly one correct). Future phases extend to 'truefalse', 'shortanswer', etc.
`qoptions_json` is a JSON array of option strings. `qanswer` is the index (0-based) of the correct option in that array — stored as an int via the char column for forward-compat with non-numeric answer keys in future qtypes.
`status` lifecycle: generated → approved | edited | rejected. The reviewer flips this per-question in the review UI; only `approved` + `edited` rows push to mod_quiz.

FIELD.NAME: draftid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_aiquiz_draft.id

FIELD.NAME: qtype
FIELD.COMMENT: multichoice | truefalse | shortanswer (G.1+)

FIELD.NAME: qtext
FIELD.COMMENT: Question stem as produced by Claude (or edited by reviewer)

FIELD.NAME: qoptions_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON array of option strings. NULL for qtypes that don't have options (shortanswer).

FIELD.NAME: qanswer
FIELD.COMMENT: Correct-answer marker: '0'..'3' for multichoice (index), 'true'/'false' for truefalse, free text for shortanswer.

FIELD.NAME: qexplanation
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional rationale Claude produced explaining why the correct answer is correct. Shown in review UI.

FIELD.NAME: sortorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Display order within the draft (1, 2, 3, ...). Lower = first.

FIELD.NAME: status
FIELD.COMMENT: generated | approved | edited | rejected

FIELD.NAME: reviewer_note
FIELD.COMMENT: Optional reviewer comment. Visible in audit history.

INDEX.NAME: idx_draft_sort
INDEX.COMMENT: Render questions in display order for a draft

INDEX.NAME: idx_status
INDEX.COMMENT: Push-to-quiz query: select where status IN ('approved','edited')
